items.name: Wren's Letter
items.description: A creased letter that smells of rain and machine oil.
items.detail: Dear fixer of strange things, Ottoline vanished at twenty to midnight, and the manor has not been quiet since. I cannot go back. The Echo remembers kindness and cruelty alike. Please finish what she began. Light the moons in the order they rise: crescent, half, full, then waning. Wren

items.name: Brass Winding Key
items.description: Warm to the touch, as if someone just let go of it.
items.detail: The bow is stamped with a single letter: T. It was made to fit a slot no lock should have.

items.name: Tallow's Lantern

description.base: A shuttered lantern with a steady blue flame.

variants.text: A shuttered lantern. Its flame burns a little low, as if Tallow is still sulking.

items.detail: The flame does not flicker, even in a draught. It gives light but no warmth, like a memory of a fire.

items.name: Ottoline's Journal
items.description: Ink-stained pages in a quick, cheerful hand.
items.detail: I hide my notes by stepping three letters forward. The engine wants three pillars: after the water, the flame. Gear plate: two, nought, three. And if the Echo ever speaks in my voice, answer kindly. It only repeats what it is given.

items.name: Torn Page (Left)
items.description: Half a recipe, the ink bloomed with damp.
items.detail: Silver solvent: three parts moon-water, one part... The rest of the line is torn away.

items.name: Torn Page (Right)
items.description: The singed half of a recipe.
items.detail: ...salt of the vault, stirred counter-clockwise until it sings. Do not breathe the steam.

items.name: Vial of Silver Solvent
items.description: A vial of liquid that gleams like melted moonlight.
items.detail: It hums faintly when you tilt it. Verdigris and rust would not survive a single drop.

items.name: Wax Cylinder
items.description: A recording cylinder labeled 'Day 90, for Wren'.
items.detail: A thumbprint is pressed into the wax beside the label. Whoever made this was in a hurry, and happy.

items.name: Spare Cog
items.description: A small brass cog with teeth worn to a shine.
items.detail: One side is engraved: 'Drive 3. Do not lose.' Someone lost it anyway.

items.name: Resonance Core
items.description: A dark crystal that hums when you speak near it.
items.detail: Say something softly and the crystal repeats it, a heartbeat late. It is the heart of the Resonance Engine.
